founder_mode_protocol.definition: "Founder Mode" is a management style characterized by direct intervention, bypassing intermediate layers, and an obsession with detail. In the context of EQ12, it means the Master Node directly orchestrates Worker Nodes without complex middleware.

directives.directive: NO BUREAUCRACY: Skip approval steps for safe operations.
DIRECT ACCESS: SSH/PowerShell Remoting directly into nodes.
SPEED OVER POLISH: Deploy working code, refactor later.
MICRO-MANAGEMENT: Monitor individual container logs directly.

execution_strategy.step: Directly provision Lenovo 10T8 as the "Muscle" node.
Force-deploy the 13-product stack via Docker Compose.
Stream logs to the Master Dashboard in real-time.
